propositions: The eval/calibration surface excludes activated project code-review criteria because _code_review_prompt_id only admits static built-in physical ids without repository context
calibrate_criterion maps non-physical ids through the default plan-review namespace and lacks a code-review membership branch
_code_review_prompt_id must accept repo_root as an optional keyword argument and resolve logical criteria from code_review.registry.effective_criteria to physical prompt ids
calibrate_criterion must branch on repo_root presence and criterion membership in effective_criteria to route active project criteria through the code-review arm
An active project code-review criterion missing its eval spec must raise EvalError containing both the logical criterion_id and the eval-spec path
